propositions: CLI rebar transition ... closed --ref HEAD with out-of-worktree REBAR_TRACKER_DIR incorrectly derives code_root from tracker parent instead of current code worktree, causing _referencing_commits to scan wrong git repository.

close_precheck._completion_precheck resolves ticket state from relocated tracker correctly but then conflates tracker parent with code repository for completion-gate config and commit evidence checks.

When external tracker parent lacks gate config, close silently treats enabled gate as disabled; when gate is enabled at tracker parent, false missing-commit diagnostics are emitted for valid trailers in code worktree.

Code root resolution must use config.repo_root(repo_root) for both gate_enabled checks and _referencing_commits git scan, while keeping ticket state reads independent through config.tracker_dir(repo_root).
